summary: Focused frontend re-test of paper-editorial light-skin contrast fixes (post iteration_88). Login → seed profile → SPA-navigate to profile → Settings → pick 'paper-editorial' → Home + Search inspection. All 4 previously-broken spots are now READABLE. No new regressions observed on paper-editorial.

verification_details.hero_more_info_button: PASS — color=rgb(255,255,255) on bg=rgba(255,255,255,0.16), border=rgba(255,255,255,0.42). Label 'More Info' + icon clearly visible over dark hero (see paper_home.jpeg).
verification_details.hero_my_list_button: PASS — same white-on-translucent pill styling, label 'My List' visible.
verification_details.hero_title_and_meta: PASS — [data-hero-content] color=rgb(246,243,236), title 'Monster' + year/runtime meta + synopsis all readable on dark backdrop.
verification_details.search_keyboard_keys: PASS — [data-testid^='tv-key-'] color=rgb(28,25,23) on bg=rgb(255,255,255) with border rgb(224,218,206). Dark letters on light keys, high contrast (see paper_search.jpeg).
verification_details.search_submit_disabled: PASS — color=rgb(87,83,78) grey on bg=rgba(28,25,23,0.06) with 1px rgba(28,25,23,0.20) border. Readable grey pill, no faint pink.
verification_details.settings_toggle_off_track: PASS — [data-testid^='toggle-'] > span has border '1px solid rgba(28,25,23,0.32)'. OFF toggle (force-SDR) shows a visible cream track with dark outline (see paper_settings.jpeg).
verification_details.settings_headings_and_rows: PASS — 'SETTINGS · APPEARANCE', 'Theme', 'Streams', 'Auto play', 'Force SDR playback', 'Video player' all render as dark ink on cream. No white-on-white regressions.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix implemented cleanly in index.css: uses [data-hero-content] wrapper + specific testids (hero-info-button, hero-list-button, tv-key-*, toggle-*, search-submit:disabled) — minimal blast radius, correctly scoped to html[data-theme='paper-editorial']. Good pattern.
Minor suggestion (non-blocking): consider adding an automated Playwright visual/computed-style contrast sweep for the light skin so future regressions on paper-editorial are caught in CI.
seed_data_creation: localStorage seed: profile p-test-1 → 'onnowtv-profiles-v1' + 'onnowtv-profiles-v1:testuser'; onboarding + whatsnew flags; onnowtv-theme:p-test-1='paper-editorial' pre-seeded to accelerate boot into the target skin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Paper-editorial light-skin contrast fixes are all live and verified via computed styles. The App.js cold-boot quirk (clears active-profile without ?profile=) still holds — always go via /profiles → click [data-testid='profile-p-test-1'] → SPA-navigate via sidebar (nav-settings/nav-home/nav-search testids exist). Sidebar in paper-editorial collapses to icons-only rail; use data-testid clicks (they still work) rather than visible label matches. Persistence key is onnowtv-theme:<profile-id>.
rca of the issue: N/A — issue resolved. Previous RCA: paper-editorial theme block re-skinned hero buttons/keys/toggles/submit assuming a dark backdrop, causing foreground==background. Mitigation applied in src/index.css 'PAPER EDITORIAL · light-mode contrast patches' block explicitly overrides color/background/border for the 5 affected element groups scoped under html[data-theme='paper-editorial'].
